output.title: Well-Lit 1-Bedroom Apartment with Cellar in Central Bonnevoie
output.description:
This 52 m² apartment offers a well-maintained living space in the central Bonnevoie district, featuring a bright, south-facing living room with laminate flooring and white walls that create a clean and neutral backdrop. The natural light enhances the open atmosphere of the main living area.

The compact kitchen follows a traditional galley layout, equipped with white cabinetry and ceramic tile flooring. While functional, it presents potential for updating to suit individual preferences. The bathroom comprises a shower-tub combination with white tiling and a single vanity, providing practical amenities within a modest footprint.

Additional storage needs are addressed by a separate cellar located in the building’s basement, offering convenient space for belongings outside the apartment. Bonnevoie itself is known for its dynamic and multicultural character, featuring a variety of dining options and the local Bonnevoie market. The neighborhood benefits from good transport connections, including access to Luxembourg’s central station, supporting accessibility throughout the city.

This property combines practical living dimensions with a location that provides urban amenities and connectivity, suitable for those seeking a residence within a lively and accessible area of the city.

highlights.text: Compact galley kitchen with functional layout
